en.headline: Work-week outlook: showers and storms early, then easing
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly cloudy conditions with showers and squally thunderstorms on Monday and Tuesday, becoming windier midweek before rain eases later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s nine-day forecast issued on Sunday afternoon points to unsettled weather at the start of the working week under a broad trough of low pressure affecting the coast of Guangdong and the northern South China Sea.

Monday is expected to be mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms, temperatures between 27 and 31 degrees Celsius. Showers are forecast to increase gradually. A moderate probability of significant rain is indicated.

Tuesday looks similar, with mainly cloudy skies, a few showers and squally thunderstorms and more rain in some areas. North to northeasterly winds will strengthen, reaching force 4 to 5 offshore later and occasionally force 6 on high ground.

From Wednesday onwards a relatively dry continental airstream is expected to affect southern China. Showers should ease, with mainly cloudy conditions, sunny intervals or periods, and temperatures remaining around 26 to 31 degrees. The remnant of Tropical Depression Saudel may still influence the western coast of southern China early in the week.
Members of the public are advised to stay updated via the Observatory’s channels as convective showers can develop quickly.

zh.headline: 工作周天氣展望：初段有驟雨雷暴 後期雨勢減弱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周一及周二大致多雲，有驟雨及狂風雷暴，中期風力較大，本周後期雨勢逐漸減弱。
body: 天文台周日下午公布的九天天氣預報指出，受影響廣東沿岸及南海北部的廣闊低壓槽影響，工作周初段天氣較為不穩定。
周一大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及狂風雷暴，氣溫介乎27至31度，雨勢會逐漸增加。顯著降雨概率屬高。
周二情況相若，大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及狂風雷暴，部分地區雨勢較多。偏北風會增強，稍後離岸達4至5級，高地間中6級。
周三起較乾的大陸氣流將逐漸影響華南，雨勢減弱，大致多雲，日間有陽光間中或有短暫陽光，氣溫約26至31度。熱帶低氣壓「蘇力」殘餘可能仍影響華南西部沿岸。
市民請留意天文台最新消息，對流性驟雨可迅速發展。
